name: rating
title: Rating
description: A score out of a few stars, as native radios.
use: A score a reader gives out of a few stars: a review, an answer to how it went. To show a score without taking one, disable the radios and say the number in words beside them.

instead.when: The answer is a position on a long scale
The options have names instead of a rank
The answer is a degree on a numbered scale with named ends

keyboard.action: Move to the star before or after and check it, as a radio group does
Enters the group at the checked star and leaves it; the group is one tab stop
Checks the star that has focus when none is checked

classes.name: rating
classes.description: The group of stars, on a fieldset named by aria-label or a legend. It carries the focus ring for its radios

classes.name: rating-input
classes.description: A star, on a radio named with its score. The radios stand in reading order, lowest first

classes.name: rating-sm
classes.description: 16px stars, for a row in a list; the default is 20px

states.name: checked
states.description: The star and every star before it fill with ink

states.name: disabled
states.description: On the radios or on the fieldset: the stars keep their ink and stop answering the pointer, to show a score

example:
<fieldset class="rating" aria-label="Rating">
  <input type="radio" class="rating-input" name="rating" value="1" aria-label="1 star">
  <input type="radio" class="rating-input" name="rating" value="2" aria-label="2 stars">
  <input type="radio" class="rating-input" name="rating" value="3" aria-label="3 stars">
  <input type="radio" class="rating-input" name="rating" value="4" aria-label="4 stars" checked>
  <input type="radio" class="rating-input" name="rating" value="5" aria-label="5 stars">
</fieldset>
